subject: Tabletop AAR: RPO alignment and runbook acceptance for regional warm failover
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma.li@clearbank.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: AuditOps Team <auditops@clearbank.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: tabletop on regional warm failover — AAR & RPO evidence needed

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for running the tabletop on Tuesday. As part of our audit closure we need a short after-action packet that ties the exercise outcomes back to the commitments in the contract. Specifically we need: 

- AAR (one-page summary) describing scenario, timeline, and lessons learned
- RPO / RTO timelines for the scenario with observed timestamps (start of failover, KV cache restoration, keystore restore completion)
- A signed runbook acceptance (we can accept a DocuSign link or a signed PDF)
- Any telemetry traces or a short sample (CSV) that shows token/kv warm-up timing for the warm standby you exercised

Can you send these by end-of-business next Thursday (2026-11-19)? AuditOps will use them to close the control objective and include the artifact in the SOC/SIG package. If you have an internal AAR that’s larger, please also include a redacted one-pager suitable for auditors.

Thanks — Emma
Emma Li
Senior Operational Risk Manager
ClearBank Operations

Attachments referenced: none in-line (we ran the tabletop in Zoom)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@clearbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, AuditOps Team <auditops@clearbank.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: tabletop on regional warm failover — AAR & RPO evidence needed

Emma — thanks for the clear ask. We’ll put together the packet and target the 2026-11-19 EOB date. High-level owners below: 

- AAR one-pager + runbook acceptance PDF: Marissa (ops & documentation)
- RPO/RTO timeline and telemetry CSV: Karthik (serving/runtime)
- Keystore/custody confirmation + sig-ready runbook: Soojin (security/compliance)

Quick notes from our end (to set expectations):
- Observed RTO for the tabletop (warm standby switch + traffic routing) was 4m 45s from initiation to steady-state under the simulated load. We’ll include more granular timestamps in the CSV.
- KV prefix warming completed in ~90s for hot prefixes; bulk backfill of cold keys took ~12 minutes in the scenario (this is expected given sharded cold-chunk fetches).
- Keystore rotation/restore was exercised; decryption keys were reloaded and validated within 2m 20s. We’ll provide a signed custody statement.

I’ll attach an internal AAR (redacted) and the CSV of key timestamps for your auditors. If AuditOps needs a different format, let us know.

Action: Marissa — please draft the one-pager and attach signed runbook acceptance. Karthik — drop the rpo-rto-timelines.csv in the shared Drive link. Soojin — prepare the keystore custody statement and runbook-signed PDF.

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Reliability & Customer Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: AAR-tabletop-20261112.pdf (redacted internal AAR)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Emma Li <emma.li@clearbank.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 08:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: tabletop on regional warm failover — AAR & RPO evidence needed

Vivek / Emma — uploading the timeline snapshot now. Notes below and CSV is attached to the Drive link referenced in the cover email.

- failover_initiated_at: 2026-11-10T15:04:22Z (initiated via policy-triggered route drain)
- first_traffic_to_warm: 2026-11-10T15:06:09Z (2m 47s)
- kv_prefix_warm_complete (hot prefixes): 2026-11-10T15:07:39Z (3m 17s)
- keystore_reload_complete: 2026-11-10T15:06:42Z (2m 20s)
- bulk_cold_backfill_end: 2026-11-10T15:16:22Z (12m 0s)

Observations: warm path latency returned to normal in ~5 minutes under the simulated 200 RPS load. Cold key backfill is the dominant tail for RPO in scenarios where a large cold-key working set is required. For the exercise we used a seeded cold set representing ~8% of active keys.

I’ve included an extra column in rpo-rto-timelines.csv that shows the KV hit-rate percentage at each timestamp; that should help auditors correlate observed recovery time with cache efficiency.

If AuditOps needs signed traces we can provide a condensed trace export (redacted) rather than raw telemetry — that’s usually sufficient.

—Karthik
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachments (reference): rpo-rto-timelines.csv (uploaded to shared Drive)

From: Emma Li <emma.li@clearbank.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: AuditOps Team <auditops@clearbank.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 16:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: tabletop on regional warm failover — AAR & RPO evidence needed

Thanks all — this is exactly what we need. I’ve reviewed the AAR and the CSV; the timestamps line up with the evidence we collected on our side. A few quick requests to close the evidence loop: 

- Please provide the signed runbook acceptance (DocuSign preferred). If you can send the DocuSign link we’ll route it internally and countersign.
- AuditOps would like a condensed trace export (redacted) showing a 2-minute window around "kv_prefix_warm_complete" for their sampling. A redacted trace is fine.
- Please confirm the explicit SLA point we exercised (section 3.2 in the contract) and note whether the tabletop demonstrated compliance or an SLA exception (if the cold-key backfill is an exception).

If you can get the DocuSign + trace by tomorrow noon CET we’ll close the control objective in our SOC pack. Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
Emma
Senior Operational Risk Manager, ClearBank
